method: Complete body and separate complete curved stem/leaf were redrawn with built-in image_gen from the locked reference after the whole-strip pose study. The body remains rigid and rolls on its alpha silhouette. A two-bone weighted FK mesh bends the independent flexible leaf during ground contact; restored cap artwork remains underneath.
cyclesRationale: Body screen diameter approximately 0.796 cells; circumference pi*0.796 yields about 0.4 revolutions per world cell.
